name: free_hugepages
synopsis: Note: glibc provides no wrappers for these system calls, necessitating the use of syscall(2).
description: Frees huge pages that were previously allocated using alloc_hugepages. It takes the address returned by alloc_hugepages and releases the memory, which is actually freed when all users have released it. Huge pages are locked in memory and not swapped.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: The address returned by alloc_hugepages() indicating which page to free.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The system call is not supported on this kernel.

bugs: These system calls have been removed and are no longer supported in kernels after Linux 2.5.54.
